title: Integrating Emotional and Linguistic Models for Ethical Compliance in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Employing adversarial LLM modules (ERIS) conditioned on opposing stances to debate emotional and ethical classifications, ensuring the representation of diverse cultural perspectives and counteracting the dominant majority opinions ingrained in the training data.

Evaluating the entropy and variance in human annotations of emotions in texts (e.g., love letters) compared to unsupervised model predictions, and using a structured adversarial debate framework to reach a more objective, conciliatory consensus.
